description: This file defines logging levels, log handler types, and logging functions for the rtLog system, including macros for different log levels and platform-specific thread ID types.

methods.name: rtLogSetLogHandler
methods.description: Sets the custom log handler function.

methods.name: rtLogGetLogHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the current log handler function.

methods.name: rtLogLevelToString
methods.description: Converts a log level enum to its string representation.

methods.name: rtLogLevelFromString
methods.description: Parses a string to get the corresponding log level enum.

methods.name: rtLog_SetOption
methods.description: Sets the logger option (RTUSE_RTLOGGER or RTUSE_RDKLOGGER).

methods.name: rtLogPrintf
methods.description: Logs a formatted message at a specified log level.
